label: CZone Control
info:
CZone digital switching via Victron Virtual Switches. v6.1 — no Signal-K.
Bidirectional via can0:
  • State    (CZone → VRM): candump PGN 127501 instance 1 (CZone Output Interface)
  • Commands (VRM → CZone): cansend PGN 127502 instance 10 (direct set-state, <10ms apply)
Key behaviors (see specification.md):
  • Decoder ignores 127501 frames with bank instance ≠ 1 — an unidentified device
    (src 0x0C) spams instance 0 "all OFF" at 5Hz; ingesting it strobed the lights (v6.0 bug).
  • Keep-alive: CZone reverts a bank-10 commanded output ~10s after the last command
    frame, so confirmed VRM-commanded ONs are re-asserted every 1s until released.
  • Confirm-and-retry: resend after 500ms (max 3 tx), revert virtual switch after 5s.
  • Echo defenses: 12s deploy guard, fresh-state dedupe (<10s), revert-echo guard.

name: ═══ CAN STATE MONITOR (candump 127501) → VIRTUAL SWITCH SYNC ═══
info:
candump can0,01F20D00:03FFFF00 captures PGN 127501 from any source/priority.
Watchdog pattern from Virtual BMS: pkill stale capture before start, chunk-safe
line parser, restart 5s after candump exits.
Decoder trusts ONLY bank instance 1 (the CZone Output Interface). Device 0x0C
broadcasts instance 0 all-OFF at 5Hz and must be ignored.

═══ VIRTUAL SWITCHES (VRM UI) ═══
info:
Input sets state from CZone. Output 2 sends commands to CZone.
NOTE: the victron-virtual-switch node does NOT preserve message properties from
input to output — a state write echoes out the command side without _czoneSync.
The engine's deploy guard, fresh-state dedupe and revert-echo guard stop these
echoes from becoming commands.

═══ CONTROL ENGINE + CONFIRM / RETRY / KEEP-ALIVE ═══
info:
Control Engine builds PGN 127502 instance 10 frames and registers them pending.
Confirm & Keep-alive engine (250ms tick):
  • confirms pending commands against 127501 state newer than the command
  • resends after 500ms, max 3 transmissions, reverts the virtual switch after 5s
  • re-asserts confirmed VRM-commanded ONs every 1s (CZone reverts bank-10
    commands ~10s after the last frame — measured 2026-07-02)
Holds live in flow context: a redeploy drops them and VRM-lit circuits turn off
~10s later (accepted limitation).
